summary: Elmet Group Co. filed an 8-K disclosing a September 23, 2026 share purchase agreement with Masan Horizon Company Limited to acquire 55,138,174 ordinary shares, a 4.99% stake in Vietnam-listed Masan High-Tech Materials Corporation (UPCoM: MSR), for about $124.75 million in a put-through trade. Closing is expected October 1, 2026, settlement October 5, 2026, subject to commercial agreements, regulatory and market approvals, and no material adverse effect. If the per-share price falls outside UPCoM's daily permitted trading band, closing defers. Watch regulatory approvals and VND conversion risk.
